name: clean_orders
description: Cleans every orders-*.csv in data/raw (or given dir) into data/clean with the same names: header id,date,customer,amount; ISO dates, normalized names, 2-decimal amounts, dedup by id, sorted. Returns per-file row counts and drop counts.
whenToUse: Whenever raw order CSV exports need (re)cleaning, including newly arrived files.

provenance.reason: clean 8 CSV files now and more exports later
